description: This file is a C source file implementing a command-line utility that uses libpcap to compile and dump a Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) expression specific to PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) packets. It contains a main function handling command-line arguments, compiling a filter expression, and outputting the filter information or errors.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point of the utility, processes command-line arguments, creates a dummy pcap handle, compiles a filter expression, and outputs the filter or error messages.
